derived_cause: COMPLIANCE_WATCH.md's 'Current posture' block (COMPLIANCE_WATCH.md:7) is an undated, present-tense prose snapshot, and lines 19-20 have not been touched since the day they were written: git blame gives b0867d4c, 2026-07-03, for all of lines 19, 20 and 21. On that date CLAUDE.md's Assets rule was absolute in-house-only ('Manus is retired. All visual and audio assets are produced in-house from vector masters (SVG) via the asset pipeline', CLAUDE.md:312), so the bullet was true as written. The rule then changed twice by owner ruling (CLAUDE.md:316, AMENDED 2026-07-25, external ENHANCEMENT permitted; CLAUDE.md:338, AMENDED AGAIN 2026-07-27, owner-commissioned NEW DESIGNS permitted for scene, tile and marketing art with recorded provenance), and two externally commissioned rasters shipped under it: the portrait tile (design-system/brand/tile/GENERATION_NOTE_composed_master.md:7 'Origin | Externally generated, commissioned by the owner', landed byte-identical from a supplied PNG per :9-14, so no vector master and no in-house render exists for it), committed 3dae890 on 2026-07-26; and the scene background (design-system/brand/GENERATION_NOTE_background.md:12, same Origin wording, with a vendor's own description at :18), committed 7b5c22c on 2026-07-27, whose commit subject is literally 'BG V1 adopted, and the external-art convention amended to match'. So the amending commit updated CLAUDE.md and wrote a generation record, and left the compliance posture bullet stating the superseded rule. Nothing in the project makes that update happen, for three separate structural reasons, each of which is sufficient on its own: (1) the provenance checklist that governs an external adoption enumerates exactly three destinations, 'in a generation record beside the asset, in the tracker row, and in the commit' (CLAUDE.md:383-386), and COMPLIANCE_WATCH.md is not one of them, so a session that followed the rule to the letter still leaves line 19 stale; (2) the only convention defining when COMPLIANCE_WATCH.md is written is (d) Docs watch (CLAUDE.md:441-444), whose trigger is a difference found when the LIVE PLATFORM docs are refreshed into docs/stake-engine-live/, i.e. a change on the platform's side of the boundary, so a change in OUR OWN asset provenance fires no trigger in it at all; and (3) the only machine that could catch a stale prose claim, scripts/qa/doc_currency_gate.mjs, was built 2026-07-29, AFTER both adoptions, and its five phase-1 classes are purely mechanical (DEAD_PATH, STALE_LINE, DEAD_SYMBOL, DEAD_COMMIT, DEAD_DOCREF, scripts/qa/doc_currency_gate.mjs:36-41), with semantic claims reachable only via the opt-in <!--CHECK: ...--> predicates at :44-48; COMPLIANCE_WATCH.md carries zero CHECK annotations (grep -c 'CHECK:' returns 0), so line 19's claim is invisible to the gate that exists precisely to stop this. The same block is a proven drifter: COMPLIANCE_WATCH.md:9-11 records its own earlier instance, 'corrected 2026-07-13, this summary had been left saying "two bet modes" after FeatureMath v2 shipped three more on 2026-07-07' - same block, same mechanism, different fact - and that repair was a point fix rather than a structural one, so the block drifted again. This is the exact failure class CLAUDE.md convention (s) names at :1044, a changing value written into an undated present-tense claim. Scope of the falsehood, stated precisely: the clause that is false is 'produced in-house from vector masters', which neither shipped asset satisfies; 'Original IP' and 'No pre-purchased or third-party licensed content' are not disproved by the generation records, since both assets were commissioned by the owner rather than purchased or licensed, and the background was commissioned from our own art (GENERATION_NOTE_background.md:47-51). The residual compliance exposure is that COMPLIANCE_WATCH.md nowhere discloses external authorship: grep for 'Externally', 'commissioned' or 'external' across the file matches only an unrelated telemetry line at :174.
reasoning: Method per convention (l.1): went to the governing specification (CLAUDE.md Assets section and its two dated amendments) before reading the cited artefacts, then read the two generation records, then established dates mechanically rather than by narration. git blame -L 19,21 COMPLIANCE_WATCH.md returns b0867d4c 2026-07-03 for the posture bullet; git log -1 on the two generation notes returns 3dae890 2026-07-26 (tile) and 7b5c22c 2026-07-27 (background). The ordering is therefore not inferred: the posture line predates the rule change and both adoptions by three to four weeks and has never been rewritten. The three no-update mechanisms were each checked against source rather than assumed: the checklist destinations are enumerated in CLAUDE.md:383-386 and do not include COMPLIANCE_WATCH.md; convention (d) at CLAUDE.md:441-444 defines the file's only update trigger as live-docs differences; and the doc currency gate's class list and opt-in predicate set were read directly, with grep -c 'CHECK:' COMPLIANCE_WATCH.md returning 0 confirming no phase-2 predicate covers the claim. The precedent instance of the same block drifting is recorded in the file itself at :9-11, which makes the mechanism a repeat rather than a one-off. Confidence HIGH because every link is a dated commit or a quoted line, and the counterfactual is checkable: adding a CHECK predicate or naming COMPLIANCE_WATCH.md in CLAUDE.md:383-386 would have caught it. The one place I deliberately did NOT overclaim is the scope of the falsehood: 'Original IP' and 'no pre-purchased or third-party licensed content' survive a commissioned work-for-hire reading, so the defect is the 'produced in-house from vector masters' clause plus the non-disclosure of external authorship, not the whole bullet.
